crossRefs.note: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even…

parallels.note: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”
Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

people.name: Achsah
people.line: Daughter of Caleb; wife of Othniel

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Kenaz
people.line: Father of Othniel, a judge of Israel

people.name: Othniel
people.line: First judge of Israel, Caleb's nephew

translations.web: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.
translations.bsb: So Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
translations.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
translations.asv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
